boundary: Synthetic exact normalized-key seeds are an upper-bound coverage experiment, not production seed-coverage evidence.
interpretation: At fixed synthetic Top-1, coherent U11 seed coverage monotonically lowers mean latency by bypassing the NL/ClayGraph fallback. p95 remains fallback-dominated until coverage is nearly complete. This supports a compiled-known-semantics fastpath plus open-world fallback, not replacement of either tier.
